method: Live paginated S3 ListObjectsV2 metadata; no large downloads. Local manifests used only for assay context, not current holdings counts.

groups.name: RNA source spine
groups.eligible_objectives: RNA reconstruction; study-aware annotation and nuisance objectives where metadata permits
groups.launch_requirements: Deduplicate accession/cell identity across source mirrors and derived arms; species/tissue/count-layer QC; do not cap cells per study.

groups.name: RNA derived arms
groups.eligible_objectives: Optional canonical representatives after source reconciliation
groups.launch_requirements: curated and curated_annot are duplicate views, not extra subjects; avoid counting both.

groups.name: Paired modalities
groups.eligible_objectives: RNA/ADT or RNA/ATAC reconstruction and same-cell modality losses
groups.launch_requirements: Do not invent triple-paired cells. BMMC CITE and multiome are different cells. Peak coordinate/genome reconciliation and donor grouping required.

groups.name: Protein acquisition
groups.eligible_objectives: Protein reconstruction on observed antibody entries; RNA/protein consistency on verified matched barcodes
groups.launch_requirements: GSE164378 and Hao reference may duplicate; panels differ and absent markers are unobserved, not zero. Raw formats require ingestion.

groups.name: Chromatin acquisition
groups.eligible_objectives: ATAC reconstruction; cross-modal objective only for actual paired samples
groups.launch_requirements: GSE129785 is ATAC-only. GSE243917 requires raw RNA/peak barcode intersection restricted to truly paired subset. GSE312129 tar may contain mixed spatial/multiome assets. Common intervals must be re-counted from fragments, not zero-filled unmatched peaks.

groups.name: Primary T-cell perturbation
groups.eligible_objectives: H1/state-conditioned response on individual donor/condition/target guide pseudobulk and independent controls
groups.launch_requirements: 44.567GB pseudobulk is aggregated data, not22M individual cells. DE stats missingness remains masked. by_donors contains overlapping donor pairs, not independent donors.

groups.name: Other perturbation
groups.eligible_objectives: Response objectives with controls and held-out perturbations/studies; paired protein response where demonstrated
groups.launch_requirements: Separate immune/primary from nonimmune cell-line auxiliary tasks; retain cell type/species context; RNA/protein filenames alone do not establish pairing.

groups.name: Knowledge graph and pathways
groups.eligible_objectives: Graph priors, gene/drug embeddings, signed regulatory and pathway objectives
groups.launch_requirements: Gene graph alone omits drug-gene edges; full rebakeoff graph identified separately. Keep relation type/sign/confidence and source provenance; knowledge-derived labels are not independent experimental targets.

groups.name: Literature
groups.eligible_objectives: Evidence retrieval or separately audited text/biology alignment
groups.launch_requirements: 24 compressed fulltext shards. Published722M token estimate is historical, not independently recounted. Text is not a count matrix or direct mechanistic ground truth.

groups.name: Presentation
groups.eligible_objectives: H4 peptide presentation/abundance only with sample/HLA/perturbation mappings
groups.launch_requirements: PXD056426 HAP1 and PXD054491 held; processed peptides and search outputs require condition-aware ingestion. Missing detected peptide is not necessarily true biological absence; no generic immune-state/presentation pairing established.

groups.name: Repertoire and spatial
groups.eligible_objectives: Optional receptor/sequence or spatial objectives only when actual chains/coordinates and linkage exist
groups.launch_requirements: RNA-derived mirrors may lack receptor chains; manifest-only files are not observations. Spatial is not interchangeable with per-cell RNA.

groups.name: Clinical
groups.eligible_objectives: Response/stratification with independently curated patient labels
groups.launch_requirements: Group by patient, accession and treatment context. Unlabeled expression alone cannot supervise response.

limitations: Inventory is selected immune-relevant prefixes, not every bucket object.
Bytes include duplicate mirrors, processed/raw copies, code and metadata; they are not independent training examples.
Fresh metadata does not verify HDF5 schemas, exact cell counts, pairing, consent, or all label semantics.
No capped feature cache or pilot subset is an acceptable substitute for all-data training.
H2/H3 objective eligibility requires actual labels/features defined by architecture; RNA/graph data alone do not prove those objectives are supervised.
